    print(f"Columns: {cols}")
    for row in rows:
        print(row)
    print("---")
    print()

conn.close()

import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
c = conn.cursor()

queries = {
    "eps_difference": "SELECT CAST(f.amount AS REAL) - g.high FROM financials f JOIN guidance g ON f.period_end = g.period_end WHERE f.period_end = '2024-11-29' AND f.months = 3 AND f.measure = 'Non-GAAP diluted net income per share' AND g.issue_date = '2024-09-12' AND g.measure = 'Diluted EPS' AND g.basis = 'non-GAAP'",
    "adjusted_operating_income": "SELECT f.amount + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM adjustments a WHERE a.period_end = f.period_end AND a.months = f.months), 0) AS adjusted FROM financials f WHERE f.period_end = '2024-11-29' AND f.months = 3 AND f.measure = 'GAAP operating income'",
    "adjusted_margin": "SELECT (f.amount + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM adjustments a WHERE a.period_end = f.period_end AND a.months = f.months), 0)) / rev.amount * 100.0 FROM financials f, financials rev WHERE f.period_end = '2024-11-29' AND f.months = 3 AND f.measure = 'GAAP operating income' AND rev.period_end = f.period_end AND rev.months = f.months AND rev.measure = 'Total revenue'",
    "margin_bridge": "SELECT (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM adjustments a WHERE a.period_end = f.period_end AND a.months = f.months), 0)) / rev.amount * 10000.0 FROM financials f, financials rev WHERE f.period_end = '2024-11-29' AND f.months = 3 AND f.measure = 'GAAP operating income' AND rev.period_end = f.period_end AND rev.months = f.months AND rev.measure = 'Total revenue'"
}

for name, sql in queries.items():
    c.execute(sql)
    result = c.fetchone()
    print(f"{name}: {result[0] if result else 'NULL'}")

conn.close()
